title: dianthus illyricus subsp. haynaldianus
intro: Dianthus illyricus subsp. haynaldianus, commonly known as the Balkan pink, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The Balkan pink is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which provide its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant is also reported to have health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing stress and anxiety, and supporting the immune system.
